root_cause: pretrain script estimates the running normaliser from its own small clean subset only (1470 samples), so xsat/cn0 sd is ~3x narrower than sup_v4's and E_s (which reuses the detector normaliser) false-fires on clean nodes
caveat: weights were fitted under the narrow normaliser; inputs now scaled by the wider one, so detector outputs shift (not re-validated for AUC)
